name: WebnD
subtitle: WEB AND DESIGN SOCIETY
aboutCaption: Building ideas, designing experiences, and creating for the web.
aboutDescription: WebnD is the web development and design society of IIT Bhubaneswar. The society brings together students interested in web technologies, UI/UX design, software development and emerging digital tools. Through workshops, projects, hackathons and collaborative learning, members build practical skills and create meaningful digital experiences.
